== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Evacuation Control (Japanese)|Evacuation Control]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/156433117/JNQ9-sgEPUGgqHWXA2sjIQ.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 89232355.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>5af0186eaec78822be0e8a6f2fd5eb948de9581fed96b784e00ec6a03dc95137</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
